title: Double Lebanese Spinach Falafel & Cos Salad Pitas
subtitle: with Mint Yoghurt & Sweet Potato Fries
description: Get a taste of Beirut with these golden falafel pita pockets, packed with crunchy cos and a refreshing mint yoghurt. We’ve paired them with some sweet potato fries for a crispy kick that makes this veggie feast a total winner.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced. Cut sweet potato into fries.
• Place on a lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and toss to coat. Bake until tender, 20-25 minutes.
• TIP: If your oven tray is crowded, divide between two trays.

• Meanwhile, finely shred cos lettuce.
• Slice cucumber into thin rounds. Roughly chop tomato.
• Pick and thinly slice mint leaves.
• In a small bowl, combine Greek-style yoghurt and mint. Season with salt and pepper and set aside.

• When the fries have 10 minutes remaining, set your air fryer to 200°C.
• Place spinach falafel in air fryer basket. Brush or spray with a drizzle of olive oil and bake until golden and heated through, 5-6 minutes.
• Bake pita bread directly on a wire oven rack until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
• TIP: No air fryer? In a large frying pan, heat olive oil (2 tbs per person) over medium-high heat. When oil is hot, cook spinach falafel, tossing, until deep golden brown, 4-6 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.

• Halve pita bread and spread with some garlic sauce.
• Halve falafel if preferred.
• Fill with some cos, tomato, cucumber and falafel. Drizzle with mint yoghurt.
• Divide spinach falafel pita pockets between plates. Serve with fries and any remaining veggies. Enjoy!
